items.title: EL Q2 Deep Dive: Organic Growth, Margin Expansion, and Strategic Category Investments
items.summary: Beauty products company Estée Lauder (NYSE:EL) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.8% year on year to $3.64 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.39 per share was 22.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
